mentions.name: Social-focused prediction market platform
mentions.description: This is a social-focused prediction market platform where users can play together on predictions, positioning itself as a more social alternative to large existing players like Kalshi.
mentions.problem: Big prediction market players like Kalshi are pushing the space hard, but there is room for a more social-focused platform where users can play together.
mentions.source_excerpt: Currently working on a prediction market platform. Although big players like kalshi are pushing this narrative very hard right now i think there is space for a more social focused platform where users can play together.
